scope: Independent news and broadcast coverage about Hazik Hussain and the original KashCrop orchard app. Plant Health Clinic and awards are researched separately.
editorialRules: Treat these as dated coverage of the original KashCrop app, not evidence of current BaghBani features or availability.
Display each excerpt with outlet, date and a working link. Excerpts are reporter narration or headline fragments, never Hazik's interview remarks relabelled as publisher praise.
Use short excerpts only; avoid reproducing full articles, unsupported yield improvements, diagnostic-accuracy promises or unverified first-in-region claims.
Do not count syndicated copies or language editions as independent reporting. Prefer the originating publication.
Do not infer an award or institutional endorsement from a news feature.
Omit the private family-health circumstances discussed in the interviews from website content; the product and public recognition are sufficient.
